title: Security Snippet Marketplace: pre-approved answer library to speed RFPs and contract onramps
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Sales and legal teams spend multiple days mapping security controls to customer questionnaires. Existing attestation bundles are bulky; customers frequently ask for small, precise statements (one- to three-paragraph answers) they can paste into RFPs. Proposal: build a curated, versioned Security Snippet Marketplace — a searchable library of short, pre-approved security answer snippets (technical, process, and policy-level) that sales and customers can reuse. Snippets are tagged by framework (SIG/CAIQ control IDs, SOC, ISO), sensitivity level, and allowed usage (public, NDA-only, CSM-only). The marketplace is surfaced both in the internal sales playbook UI and as an export feature for customers (PDF/markdown) that can be attached to contract negotiations. Pricing/packaging experiment: tie a small credit to high-effort snippets (audit-evidence attachments) and surface a pricing trigger that coordinates with Entitlement & Billing to offer evidence credits when teams exceed a threshold, enabling faster closure while tracking unit economics. This ticket covers product spec, approvals model, telemetry, and rollout plan for the MVP.
acceptance_criteria: Searchable library UI in Console where internal users can filter by framework, sensitivity, and usage policy
Snippet approval flow: Draft -> Security review -> Approved version with effective date and reviewer metadata
Ability to export selected snippets as a single PDF/markdown bundle for attachments to RFPs
Telemetry: downloads, snippet reuse by customer, average time-to-answer saved vs baseline, and pricing-trigger activation events
Pricing experiment wiring: evidence-credit generation when a user exports > X high-effort snippets; telemetry ties back to cost-per-evidence metric
tasks: PM: finalize taxonomy for tags (framework IDs, sensitivity, allowed usage)
Design: mock marketplace list, snippet detail modal, and export UX
Eng: build snippets service (CRUD + versioning) and Console integration endpoints
Security: define review rubric and automated checklist for low-sensitivity snippets
Revenue Ops / Billing: define evidence-credit mechanic and implement entitlement hook
Legal: review export language for public vs NDA-only snippets
Pilot: 2 enterprise accounts (assigned CSMs) run through 3 RFPs and report time saved

notes: Trade-offs: faster negotiation vs potential over-sharing of sensitive internal controls. Mitigation: strict sensitivity tagging and export gating (public vs NDA-only).
Rollout plan: internal-only pilot (CSM + Sales) for 6 weeks -> gated customer beta for Enterprise accounts -> general availability with metadata retention for audits.

Metrics: target 30% reduction in time-to-answer for pilot accounts; target 10% uplift in deal velocity for affected opportunities. Track net new evidence-credit cost and adjust pricing triggers if CAC impacted.
Related initiatives: aligns with Answers-Led pricing experiments and the attestation bundling work but focuses on bite-sized snippets rather than full CAIQ bundles.
